name: piece
meaning: One countable item; the usual inventory unit of discrete goods.

name: set
meaning: A set of items sold or counted as one; its content is product data, so it converts only through a product unit.

name: kilogram
meaning: Base unit of mass; 3 decimals hold one gram.

name: gram
meaning: 0 decimals, so grams and kilograms convert exactly both ways (ADR-0056 rule 7).

name: tonne
meaning: 1000 kilograms (metric ton); 6 decimals hold one gram, so tonnes, kilograms and grams convert exactly both ways.

name: metre
meaning: Base unit of length; 3 decimals hold one millimetre.

name: centimetre
meaning: 1 decimal, so centimetres, metres and millimetres convert exactly.

name: cubic metre
meaning: 6 decimals hold one millilitre, so cubic metres, litres and millilitres convert exactly both ways.

name: hour
meaning: Activity and labour time; 2 decimals; hours and minutes convert inexactly both ways, days to hours exactly.

name: day
meaning: Calendar or working day as a quantity; 2 decimals.
